response.justification: The candidate brings valuable and relatively rare geospatial expertise critical for routing pipelines, plus demonstrated large-scale systems thinking from infrastructure work. However, significant gaps exist in modern C++ skills (last serious work 11+ years ago; currently TypeScript-focused) and no production routing/navigation experience. The role requires immediate C++ proficiency for critical pipeline work. While the candidate demonstrates the learning mindset valued by the role, the technical risk is substantial without evidence of capability to quickly ramp up on modern C++ systems programming.
strengths: Deep geospatial/GIS expertise through GISCollective founder role and Green Map production platform work
Proven large-scale systems thinking from Dunnhumby handling millions of requests per second in microservices
Multi-language background demonstrates adaptability and proven ability to learn new technical domains
concerns: C++ expertise severely outdated (last substantive work in 2015; currently TypeScript/Node.js focused)
No production routing engine, navigation system, or tile-based platform experience
Last 6+ years focused on high-level application development rather than systems engineering
